messages.content: What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?

function.name: get_earliest_reference
function.description: Retrieve the earliest historical reference of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: Source to fetch the reference. Default is 'scriptures'

message.reasoning: We need to answer: earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record. Likely earliest non-Christian references: Josephus (Antiquities 18.3), Tacitus (Annals 15.44), Pliny the Younger (letters). Also maybe the earliest Christian references: the Gospels (written ~70-90 CE). But question: "earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" So likely earliest mention outside Christian texts: Josephus, about 93-94 CE. Also Tacitus wrote about Christ's execution under Pontius Pilate, around 116 CE. So earliest is Josephus. Provide details. Also mention that some scholars debate authenticity of Josephus passage. Provide citations. Use function get_earliest_reference? That function returns earliest reference of a person. We can call it for Jesus. Let's call get_earliest_reference with name "Jesus Christ".
